data.display_address: Onda by Kasco, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover refined waterfront living at ONDA by KASCO, a contemporary residential development designed for those seeking style, comfort, and convenience. This elegant 1-bedroom apartment offers a thoughtfully planned interior with premium finishes, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere ideal for modern living.

Situated in a well-connected location, the development provides easy access to Dubai's key business districts, lifestyle destinations, and everyday essentials. Whether you're a first-time buyer, an end-user, or an investor, this residence presents an excellent opportunity to own a home in one of Dubai's promising new communities.

Property Features:
- 1 Bedroom
- 2 Bathrooms
- 822.68 Sq. Ft.
- Spacious living and dining area
- Open-plan kitchen
- Built-in wardrobes
- Balcony
- Floor-to-ceiling windows
- Covered parking
- Swimming pool
- Fully equipped gym
- Landscaped leisure areas
- Children's play area
- 24/7 security
- High-speed elevators
- Concierge services
- Premium residential development
